summary: In Season 9, an Aura team replaces the old Thelendor Rally team as the top composition for Fallen Shadow Spire. Talethia serves as the core DPS for this strategy but requires at least Inspiration 2, preferably Inspiration 5, to perform effectively. The recommended Aura roster consists of Talethia, Anneliesis, Diantha, Lincos, and Shahla. Positioning is crucial: Anneliesis is placed behind Talethia, while Lincos and Shahla must be positioned close to the deer boss.

meta_changes: Aura teams (led by Talethia) have overtaken Thelendor Rally teams as the #1 strategy for Fallen Shadow Spire in Season 9.
tips: Do not pull specifically for Thelendor for Fallen Shadow Spire; build an Aura team instead.
Ensure Talethia is at least Inspiration 2 (ideally Inspiration 5) before using her to carry Fallen Shadow Spire.
Position Lincos and Shahla close to the deer boss in Fallen Shadow Spire.
